evidence.quote: if (typeof rate !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(rate) || rate < 0 || rate > 1) throw new Error('Tax rate must be a fraction between 0 and 1');

answer.rationale: The range rule (a tax rate must be a fraction between 0 and 1) is a domain invariant on a value the domain receives. It is enforced in the application service, not in a value object or the domain's TaxRates module. The domain only validates the country, so nothing in the domain enforces the rate rule. This is more than input parsing.
